besluite.fout: 'bekend vir' copies English 'known for'; Afrikaans says 'bekend om'.
besluite.rede: Fixes a direct translation from English without moving the meaning; protected names untouched.
'groei tot 'n dorp' is standard natural Afrikaans; 'uitgroei tot' is a lateral move in a sentence carrying the protected 'soms selfs tot 'n stad'.
'het vinnig tot 'n groot stad gegroei' already reads well; the proposal is only different, and change 2 was not kept so there is no matching to restore.

besluite.fout: 'om die steenkoolmyne gegroei' is terse and a Grade 5 reader may stumble on 'om' before seeing it means 'around'.
besluite.rede: 'rondom' says the same spatial relation (grew around the mines) more clearly; protected words stay intact.
'versprei lê' is a natural Afrikaans form (lê versprei) and this is a glossary definition shared across lessons, so a lateral rewording must not be made here.
